correctness.rationale: Fix L0={0,suc} and irregular S,Z whose binary characteristic sequences realize each finite block infinitely often. A first-order unary predicate definition on the standard successor structure, relationalized to its bounded-degree path graph, is eventually a finite-radius Boolean window function by Gaifman locality (background local sentences have fixed truth values). Two mutual definitional interpretations give eventual local rules F,G. Since every long window appears arbitrarily late in both irregular sequences, GF=id on the full bi-infinite binary shift and FG=id, making F reversible. Conversely finite-radius reversible rules are definable by first-order formulas reading fixed predecessor/successor windows beyond a hard-coded finite prefix, and completeness of T(S),T(Z) upgrades inverse truth on the standard models to joint definitional extension. Relative classes are countably infinite, their quotient continuum, and radius-one forward and inverse pairs are six shifted coordinate projections or complements. Independent exhaustive inspection of all 256² radius-one rule pairs and all 32 five-bit windows confirmed exactly six inverse pairs.

originality.rationale: Andréka et al. already define irregular T(S), prove completeness and continuum-many inequivalent theories by a countability argument; those conclusions are explicitly prior. The assessed contribution is an exact iff criterion under fixed successor reduct, identifying all mutual tail interpretations with invertible sliding block codes. Standard Gaifman locality and reversible CA definitions are credited. Their broad unrestricted inequivalence counting does not supply this relative classification.
residual_risks: Unrestricted definitional equivalence is intentionally out of scope; more general symbolic-dynamics literature may contain an equivalent tail-conjugacy observation.

value.rationale: The fixed-language reduct is natural because it isolates the predicate-renaming problem from arbitrary redefinition of successor. A concrete necessary and sufficient symbolic-dynamical criterion for equivalence between highly complex complete theories is a structural classification; it is useful independent of an algorithm deciding equivalence for arbitrary infinite sequences.

scientific_limitations: Strictly L0-fixed joint definitional extensions; unrestricted equivalence may redefine 0/suc and is not classified.
Forward and inverse radius-one six-rule corollary does not cover all-radius reversible CA; no decidability for arbitrary infinite sequences.
